text: Posing for his friend Basil Hallward beside an Egyptian cat statue, the handsome young aristocrat Dorian Gray [wishes his portrait would age instead of him|wants|cheating death and age]. After he cruelly breaks with the singer Sibyl Vane and she takes her life, the painting begins to change, and he [locks it away in his old schoolroom|images|pictures, screens and recordings]. Years pass, London society marvels at his unchanging face, and the canvas warps into [a hideous record of his sins|threat|the enemy within] that he [kills his friend to keep hidden|wrong|a life taken].
